_taxonomy.field_notes: Status labels for modules under src/. Same semantics as scripts_metadata.json. See docs/status_taxonomy.md.

src/genesis_grid/__init__.py.description: Public re-exports for the active engine package.

src/genesis_grid/backend.py.description: NumPy vs CuPy switch via GENESIS_USE_CUPY env. Cross-cutting; imported by every rule.

src/genesis_grid/core.py.description: GenesisState, GenesisParams, and the step() orchestrator. Heart of the active engine.
src/genesis_grid/core.py.notes: GenesisParams is a flat bag of 18 knobs with no per-rule grouping or validation — flagged in the architecture analysis as a future refactor target.

src/genesis_grid/adapter.py.description: GenesisGridEngine — wraps core.step() to conform to the GenesisEngine protocol. Defines the 7-rule DEFAULT_RULES pipeline.
src/genesis_grid/adapter.py.notes: DEFAULT_RULES here differs from the 3-rule pipeline used by genesis_measure.py. Two parallel pipeline definitions exist; consider extracting a named registry of pipelines.

src/genesis_grid/diagnostics.py.description: Read-only diagnostic computations (vortex detection, local coherence). NOT in the step() pipeline.

src/genesis_grid/relax.py.description: Soft relaxation rule — small Laplacian diffusion plus geometry damping.
src/genesis_grid/relax.py.notes: Duplicates compression_rule's mutations on state.tau, ux, uy. When both are in the same pipeline (as in adapter.py's DEFAULT_RULES) they overwrite each other in sequence. Candidate for consolidation.

src/genesis_grid/rules_alignment.py.description: Alignment rule — neighbor-coupled sin-torque. Writes extra[grad_align], extra[dtheta_align].
src/genesis_grid/rules_alignment.py.notes: Cleanest rule in the package. Pure: returns torque, no state mutation.

src/genesis_grid/rules_compression.py.description: Compression rule — updates tau, ux, uy, C; computes detF; applies shell-geometry feedback.
src/genesis_grid/rules_compression.py.notes: Architecture analysis flagged this as a 'god-module' — six concerns in one rule. Also uses forward differences which contribute to the measured θ ≈ π/4 lattice-bias in the SSB study. Tab-indented while every other rule uses spaces (formatting drift).

src/genesis_grid/rules_curvature.py.description: Curvature rule — torque toward the direction of the Laplacian of the geometry field.
src/genesis_grid/rules_curvature.py.notes: Contains a dead stub at the top (lines 5-12) that references state.grid (which doesn't exist) before being overridden by the real definition below. Should be deleted as part of cleanup.

src/genesis_grid/rules_dipoles.py.description: Head-tail dipole interaction across deformed grid.
src/genesis_grid/rules_dipoles.py.notes: Not in the genesis_measure.py 3-rule pipeline; used by adapter.py's DEFAULT_RULES.

src/genesis_grid/rules_locking.py.description: locking_postprocess — the post= hook. Amplifies phase/triad torques in compressed cores and scales total torque by (1 - lock * C).
src/genesis_grid/rules_locking.py.notes: Two of its three inputs (phase_torque, tri_torque) are never produced by the genesis_measure pipeline, so the lock currently only freezes torque — it doesn't amplify anything.

src/genesis_grid/rules_phase.py.description: Phase rule — fourfold cos potential, writes extra[phase_torque] for the locker to amplify.

src/genesis_grid/rules_triads.py.description: L-shaped 3-body triad rule with absolute target orientations. Writes extra[tri_torque].
src/genesis_grid/rules_triads.py.notes: Has a sibling, rules_triads_relative.py, which writes the same extra key. Whichever is imported wins. Consider a params.triads_mode selector.

src/genesis_grid/rules_triads_relative.p.description: Rotation-invariant variant of the triad rule. Same extra key as rules_triads.py.
src/genesis_grid/rules_triads_relative.p.notes: A/B alternative to rules_triads.py. No selector — choice is encoded in which one is imported into the rule list. Pick a winner or add an explicit mode flag.

src/genesis_grid/ui_matplotlib.py.notes: One of three matplotlib UI iterations. Pick a winner and demote the others to superseded.

src/genesis_grid/ui_matplotlib2.py.notes: One of three matplotlib UI iterations.

src/genesis_grid/ui_matplotlib3.py.notes: One of three matplotlib UI iterations.

src/genesis_grid/ui_vispy2.py.notes: One of three VisPy UI iterations.

src/genesis_grid/ui_vispy3.py.notes: One of three VisPy UI iterations.

src/genesis_scheme/__init__.py.description: Public exports for the legacy package. ALSO eagerly imports .engine.adapter.EngineV0 and .engine_v1.adapter.EngineV1.
src/genesis_scheme/__init__.py.notes: References subdirectories (engine/, engine_v1/) that do not exist in the repo. `from src.genesis_scheme import *` will raise ImportError. The four scripts using this package (animate_2d, animate_field, animate_gray_scott, main_scalar_demo) must be importing leaf modules directly to avoid this. Either restore the missing subpackages or strip the eager imports.

src/genesis_scheme/algebra.py.description: Scalar F/A duality. The Nov 30 2025 1D proof-of-concept.
src/genesis_scheme/algebra.py.notes: Per timeline.mmd, replaced by the genesis_grid engine. Imported by main_scalar_demo.py.

src/genesis_scheme/algebra_2d.py.notes: Per timeline.mmd, replaced by the genesis_grid engine. Imported by animate_2d.py.

src/genesis_scheme/field_unity.py.description: FieldUnity — diffusion/reaction on a 2D grid. Engine v0 era.
src/genesis_scheme/field_unity.py.notes: Per timeline.mmd, replaced by the genesis_grid engine. Imported by animate_field.py.

src/genesis_scheme/gray_scott.py.description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion state. Engine v1 (U,V) two-field era.
src/genesis_scheme/gray_scott.py.notes: Per timeline.mmd, replaced by the genesis_grid engine. Imported by animate_gray_scott.py.

src/genesis_scheme/engine_interface.py.notes: Apr 2026 restructure per timeline.mmd. The genesis_grid adapter conforms to this protocol.
